fact: TechHive Advisory reviews a draft Artificial Intelligence law introduced in Angola, a comprehensive framework for the development, supply and use of AI with a risk-based approach and extraterritorial reach; the document gives no date for the draft, so its published date of 2025-12-29 is used.
